Head_and_Face: Bill is medium-length, slightly decurved, and dark.
White eyebrow stripe contrasts with dark eye line.
Head is small and compact.
Body_and_Plumage: Breeding plumage: rich chestnut-red back and wing coverts contrasting with dark brown crown and black belly patch.
Non-breeding plumage is uniform grey-brown above with white underparts.
Body exhibits compact proportions of modest small shorebird size with relatively broad wings.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are dark grey to black and relatively short.
Wings are pointed with white wing stripe visible in flight.
Tail is short and slightly forked.

Head_and_Face: Bill is moderately long, straight, and slightly upturned at base, red at base transitioning to dark tip.
Eye is dark with pale orbital ring.
Head is small relative to body.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is mottled brown above with heavily streaked breast and white belly.
Body exhibits medium proportions of moderate-sized wading shorebird.
Wings display white trailing edge and white rump visible in flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are bright red-orange, long and slender, visible even at distance.
Tail is short with white edges.
Neck is medium-length.

Head_and_Face: Bill is very long, straight, and dark, vastly exceeding head length.
Supercilium (eyebrow stripe) is pale contrasting with dark crown.
Head is small with pale facial stripe.
Body_and_Plumage: Breeding plumage: rich rufous-orange underparts with barred flanks and olive-green back with black centers.
Non-breeding plumage is uniform grey-brown above with pale grey underparts.
Body exhibits medium proportions of moderate shorebird size.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are yellowish-green to olive and moderately long.
Wings are pointed with white rump and tail edges visible in flight.
Feeding behavior features rapid side-to-side bill sweeping motion.

Head_and_Face: Bill is long, laterally compressed, and bright orange-red with chisel-like tip.
Eyes are yellow with prominent red orbital ring.
Head and neck are entirely black.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is striking black and white: entirely black head, neck, and upperparts contrasting with pure white underparts.
Body exhibits large proportions of substantial coastal shorebird size.
Wings are broad with bold white wing bars visible in flight.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are pinkish-red and stout.
Tail is black with white base.
Body exhibits robust stocky build.

Head_and_Face: Enormous bill with distensible gular pouch extending from lower mandible.
Bill is enormous and elongated, vastly exceeding head length, with bright orange, yellow, or pink coloration during breeding.
Head is large with prominent pouch.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is predominantly white, grey, or brown depending on species and season.
Body exhibits heavy barrel-shaped torso of very large proportions.
Wings are extremely broad and long with dark flight feathers contrasting lighter body.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are short and webbed with all four toes connected.
Neck is long and S-curved.
Tail is short and wedge-shaped.

Head_and_Face: Head is glossy black with vibrant orange-yellow auricular patches extending from ear region down neck sides.
Bill is long, slender, and black with bright orange-pink lower mandible and base.
Eyes are dark on black head.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is black and white: head, back, and flippers are glossy black.
Breast and belly are white transitioning to pale yellow on upper breast.
Body exhibits upright torpedo-shaped profile of very large penguin proportions.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Flippers are stiff and paddle-shaped, black on both surfaces.
Feet are black and webbed.
Neck is elongated with orange coloration.

Head_and_Face: Bill is massive, long, and hooked at tip, composed of multiple horny plates, yellow to pink with dark tip.
Nostrils (nares) are tubular and positioned on sides of bill.
Head and underparts are white.
Body_and_Plumage: Plumage is predominantly white with dark brown to black upperwings, back, and tail.
Body exhibits large proportions with exceptionally broad wingspan among flying seabirds.
Wings are extremely long and narrow optimized for dynamic soaring.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Legs are pink to flesh-colored with webbed feet.
Tail is wedge-shaped.
Body exhibits streamlined profile.

Head_and_Face: Head is relatively short with arched rostrum and two blowholes on top.
Skin is mottled grey to greyish-black with distinctive white patches from barnacles and whale lice.
No dorsal fin present; multiple dorsal knuckles along posterior back.
Body_and_Plumage: Robust spindle-shaped body of enormous proportions.
Skin is mottled grey with white patches created by barnacles.
Baleen plates are cream-colored, densely packed in numerous rows along each side.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, remarkably elongated relative to body size.
Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge and central notch.
Skin texture is rough with callosities.

Head_and_Face: Head is rounded without distinct beak.
Oval white eye patch behind and slightly above eye.
Dorsal fin is extremely tall and triangular, towering above the backline in males.
Body_and_Plumage: Body is predominantly glossy black with contrasting white patches.
White ventral surface from jaw to tail.
Greyish-white saddle patch behind dorsal fin.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Flippers (pectoral fins) are broad and paddle-shaped, black on outer surface, white on inner.
Tail flukes are broad with smooth trailing edge.
Teeth are conical and interlocking, numerous and prominently visible when mouth is open.

Head_and_Face: Head is rounded with broad downturned snout covered in coarse bristles (vibrissae).
Eyes are small and positioned laterally.
No external ears visible.
Body_and_Plumage: Skin is smooth and hairless displaying grey to brownish-grey coloration with lighter ventral surface.
Body exhibits robust fusiform form of substantial marine mammal proportions.
No dorsal fin present.
Limbs_and_Anatomy: Forelimbs modified into broad paddle-shaped flippers without nails.
Tail fluke is distinctive bilobate (dolphin-like) shape with horizontal orientation.
Small downward-curving tusks present in mature males.
